Analyze the need for sustainable development in the context of the current global scenario. B. Read the case let and Answer the following TerraTech, a mid-sized manufacturing firm, adopted the Triple Bottom Line approach to redefine its performance metrics. Beyond profit, it began measuring its impact on people and the planet. The company invested in employee wellness programs, supported local education initiatives, and transitioned to low-emission production methods. Financially, it remained stable while gaining community trust and reducing regulatory risks. Annual reports now include social and environmental indicators alongside financial data. This shift attracted ethically-minded investors and improved employee retention. TerraTech’s leadership credits the model for fostering long-term resilience and stakeholder loyalty. Explain the Triple Bottom-Line framework in the above context that reshape corporate priorities.
